Assam Schedule VIII, Form No. 127 
High Court Criminal Form No. (M) 106 
ORDER SHEET 
IN THE COURT OF HABUNG TANGU, CHIEF JUDICIAL MAGISTRATE 
SEPPA, EAST KAMENG, ARUNACHAL PRADESH 
Maintenanace Case No. 03/2025 
Smti Mingpung Taba (Keyang) & 2 Others –vs- Shri Jotting Keyang  
Date 
Order 
Signature 
 
30.05.2025 
 
 
The petitioner is represented by her Legal Aid Counsel Adv. 
Raka Singhi. 
 
The present application has been filed under section 144 of 
the BNSS, 2024 claiming maintenance for the petitioners namely 
Smti Mingpung Taba, Master John Keyang & Miss Ruth Keyang 
from the respondent Shri Joting Keyang who is the husband/father 
of petitioners. 
Heard the learned Counsel for the petitioner and perused 
the case record.  
 The case is admitted. 
 
Next date is fixed on 10.06.2025 for appearance of 
respondent and reply, if any and consideration of interim prayer. 
 
Issue notice to the respondent Shri Joting Keyang.  
 
The petitioner shall take steps.  
  
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
(Habung Tangu) 
CJM, Seppa 
 
 
^
